headline: Sinuous form of Shenzhen Natural History Museum emulates "a piece of landscape"
context: Granite cloaks the sweeping form of Shenzhen Natural History Museum, completed in China by architecture studios 3XN, B+H Architects and Zhubo Design. Now officially open in the Pingshan District, the 100,000-square-metre building was planned as a new cultural landmark for Shenzhe
